actions.name: Move
actions.effect: Move up to your Speed.

actions.name: Rush
actions.effect: Move up to three times your Speed (less your Load Strain) in a straight line. You are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Leap
actions.effect:
The following actions do not require a check; longer or higher jumps are an Athletics check, and count as part of the Leap.

❶ Quick Jump. Leap up to half your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.

❷ Standing Long Jump. Leap up to your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.

❸ Running Long Jump. Move at least half your Speed and Leap in the same direction up to your 1.5x of your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.

actions.name: Crawl
actions.effect: While prone, Move up to half your Speed.

actions.name: Stand
actions.effect: Get up from prone.

actions.name: Climb
actions.effect: An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you fall.

actions.name: Swim
actions.effect: An Athletics check against a Threshold the GM sets. On a success you move half your Speed (your full Speed on a critical success). On a critical failure you sink.

actions.name: Tumble Through
actions.effect: Acrobatics against the target's Awareness Threshold, to move through a foe's space. On a success you pass through, though their space is difficult terrain for this move. On a failure your movement stops in front of them.

actions.name: Squeeze
actions.requirements: You are entering a space narrower than your token size, but at least half as wide.
actions.effect:
Move up to 3 feet, regardless of your Speed. While any part of you is in that space:
You are Off-Guard.
Evade is unavailable to you.
You can attack only with weapons that have the Close trait.

A space narrower than half your own stops you entirely. For a Medium creature that means a gap of 1½ feet or less.

actions.name: Strike
actions.effect:
Attack with a weapon or an unarmed blow. Roll Melee (or Ranged, for a weapon that leaves your hand) against Evade or Guard:

❶ Quick Strike. A one-action Strike to the Torso, with the following effects:
Critical Success One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any).
Success One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any). Protection applies even if the struck Zone is Exposed.
Graze No damage.
Miss No damage.

❷ Deliberate Strike. A two-action Strike, with the following effects:
Critical Success Double damage to a Zone of your choosing. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Success Normal damage to the Torso.
Graze One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any).
Miss You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.

❸ Committed Strike. A three-action Strike, with the following effects:
Critical Success Double damage to a Zone of your choosing. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Success Normal damage to the Torso. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Graze One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any). You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.
Miss You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.

actions.name: Gain Control
actions.requirements: You are in a Bind with your target, and they are no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Melee against the target’s Guard, with the following effects:
Critical Success You Control the weapon, and the target is Off-Guard until its next Opportunity.
Success You Control the weapon.
Graze A neutral Bind forms.
Miss You pressed badly. The target Controls your weapon instead.
Special While you Control the weapon, the target takes −2 Situation to attacks with it and has an Exposed Zone of your choice.

actions.name: Close
actions.effect: Step toward that foe. The Bind does not end due to this movement, and the Controlled weapon cannot Intercept you.

actions.name: Grapple
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is Restrained until the end of the next round.
SuccessThe target is Grabbed until the end of the next round.
GrazeNo effect.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

If you spend more than one action on Grapple, it gains the following effects:
❷ Tackle. Move, then Grapple. Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is Restrained until the end of the next round and knocked Prone.
SuccessThe target is Grabbed until the end of the next round and knocked Prone. You fall Prone adjacent to them.
GrazeNo effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender’s choice.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity, and fall Prone adjacent to them.

actions.name: Shove
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Shove Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is pushed 6 feet. You may Move as part of this action, if it is in the same direction.
SuccessThe target is pushed 3 feet.
GrazeNo effect.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

If you spend more than one action on Shove, it gains the following effects:
❷ Heave. You set your feet and put your weight behind it. Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is pushed 12 feet.
SuccessThe target is pushed 6 feet.
GrazeNo effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender’s choice.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Trip
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Trip Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is knocked Prone, and takes damage equal to your Might.
SuccessThe target is knocked Prone.
GrazeNo effect.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

Special If the target’s Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.

If you spend more than one action on Trip, it gains the following effects:
❷ Leg Sweep. Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is knocked Prone, takes damage equal to your Might, and becomes Exposed [Legs].
SuccessThe target is knocked Prone and becomes Exposed [Legs].
GrazeNo effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender’s choice.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

Special If the target’s Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.

actions.name: Disarm
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Disarm Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares.
SuccessTheir grip is loosened: -2 Situation penalty to attacks with it, and the next Disarm against them gains a +2 Situation bonus, until they spend an Interact to resettle it
GrazeNo effect.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

Special If the target’s Arms are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.

If you spend more than one action on Disarm, it gains the following effects:
❸ Wrench. Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe item flies from their grip and lands 1d10 squares away, in a direction of your choosing.
SuccessThe item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares.
GrazeNo effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender’s choice.
MissYou overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

Special If the target’s Arms are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or are already Grabbing or Restraining the target, the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessMove the target up to 6 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles.
SuccessMove the target up to 3 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles.
GrazeNo effect.
MissThe target can move you up to 3 feet as though it Repositioned you.

If you spend more than one action on Reposition, it gains the following effects:
❷ Haul. Roll Athletics against Evade or Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessMove up to your full Speed, bringing the target with you.
SuccessMove up to half your Speed, bringing the target with you
GrazeNo effect, and you are Exposed in a Zone of the defender’s choice.
MissThe target can move you up to 6 feet the same way.

actions.name: Raise a Shield
actions.effect: Gain your shield's Gear bonus to Guard until your next Opportunity. You must be wielding it.

actions.name: Recenter
actions.effect: Gather yourself: clear every Exposed Zone on you (except one Exposed by a Posture) and end any Bind you are in.

actions.name: Take Cover
actions.requirements: You have Cover, or Greater Cover, or are wielding a tower shield.
actions.effect:
Press yourself into your cover. Your Cover improves by one grade. Adjust the Zones Covered to match. This lasts until you Move, Step or Attack.

Special A raised tower shield gives you Cover with nothing to get behind, so Taking Cover behind one gives you Greater cover.

actions.name: Escape
actions.effect:
Break free of a grab, a restraint, or anything holding you.

Roll your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against the grabber's Endure, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou are no longer Grabbed or Restrained, and may Step ⓿.
SuccessYou are no longer Grabbed or Restrained.
FailureThe Grabbed or Restrained condition persists.
Critical FailureThe condition persists and their hold improves. If you were Grabbed, you are now Restrained.

actions.name: Step
actions.effect:
Move up to half your Speed. Step has no Traits at all, which is the point: it never provokes Intercepts or other Reactions. Stepping ends any Bind you are in (Close excepted).
You cannot Step into difficult terrain.

actions.name: Parry
actions.requirements: You have Guard Training, and a rigid weapon, shield, or permitted natural weapon in hand.
actions.effect: Answer an attack with Guard at a +2 Situation bonus. If you Stop a Deliberate or Committed Strike, you take Control of the attacking weapon instead of forming a neutral Bind, and you may at once make a Quick Strike ⓿ against its owner (the riposte). A Stopped Quick Strike gives only a neutral Bind.

actions.name: Void
actions.effect: Answer an attack with Evade at a +2 Situation bonus. If the attack is Stopped, you may Step in any direction.

actions.name: Counter
actions.requirements: You are Expert in Melee; the attacker is within your Reach and the attack is a melee attack.
actions.effect: Answer the attack with a Quick Strike of your own. You gain no bonus to your Defense. Roll both; resolve both. You cannot Counter a Counter or an Intercept, and the fighter you Counter rolls only their basic Defense against it.

actions.name: Intercept
actions.trigger: A foe Moves from outside your Total Reach to inside it, or Strikes you with an Unwieldy weapon from inside its Unwieldy distance.
actions.effect: Make a Quick Strike against them at the moment they enter. Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops their movement; anything less and it continues.

actions.name: Pass
actions.effect: Do nothing at this Opportunity. You may still use Reactions. When a full circuit passes in which everyone Passes, the round ends. You cannot Pass while Preparing.

actions.name: Seek
actions.effect:
Roll one Awareness against the Stealth of anything Hiding, or against a Threshold the GM sets for a hidden object. Covers everything within 30 feet, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessAs Success, but the creature moves two states.
SuccessThe creature moves one state toward Observed: Undetected becomes Hidden, Hidden becomes Concealed, Concealed becomes Observed.
FailureYou learn nothing.
Critical FailureYou commit to the wrong place. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Hide
actions.requirements: You are currently benefiting from at least Lesser Cover, or from Concealment.
actions.effect:
Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature around you (including your Allies), with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou are Hidden to the creature, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round.
SuccessYou are Hidden to the creature.
FailureThey still see you.
Critical FailureYou have drawn the eye. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Sneak
actions.requirements: You are (or believe you are) currently at least Hidden from at least one creature.
actions.effect:
Move up to half your Speed while staying Hidden or Undetected. You must end this movement with Concealment or at least Lesser Cover from each creature you wish to remain at least Hidden from.
Roll one Stealth against the Awareness of every creature to which you are currently at least Hidden (including your Allies), with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round.
SuccessYou move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected.
FailureYou are Observed during your movement.
Critical FailureYou are Observed, and you are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity.

If you spend more than one action on Sneak, it gains the following effects:
❷ Creep. Roll Stealth against the Awareness of every creature to which you are currently at least Hidden (including your Allies), with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected, and they are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round.
SuccessYou move and remain Hidden and/or Undetected.
FailureYou realize you would be Observed if you moved, and may choose to not move after all.
Critical FailureYou are Observed during your movement.

actions.name: Point Out
actions.effect: Indicate a creature you have located, whether you can see it or it is merely Hidden to you. It becomes Hidden rather than Undetected, or Concealed rather than Hidden, to any ally who can hear or see you.

actions.name: Demoralize
actions.effect:
Roll Intimidation against the target’s Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is Frightened 2.
SuccessThe target is Frightened 1.
FailureNo effect.
Critical FailureNo effect, and it is emboldened: +1 Situation bonus to its Attacks against you until the end of the next round.

If you spend more than one action on Demoralize, it gains the following effects:
❷ Break Them. Roll Intimidation against the target’s Guard, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is Frightened 3 and Heedless.
SuccessThe target is Frightened 2.
FailureThe target is Frightened 1.
Critical FailureNo effect.

actions.name: Feint
actions.effect:
Roll Guile against the target's Awareness, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessThe target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of the next round.
SuccessThe target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next Opportunity.
FailureNo effect.
Critical FailureYou overcommit. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Recall Knowledge
actions.effect:
Learn something true about a creature, place, or object. Possible topics include: Defense Thresholds, Protection & Armor Materials, Weaknesses, Resistances & Immunities, Attack Thresholds, Special Abilities, and Maximum Vigor.

Roll a Lore or relevant Skill check against the level-based Threshold of your target, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou recall all facts about two topics.SuccessYou recall all facts about one topic.FailureYou recall nothing.Critical FailureYou recall all (incorrect) facts about one topic.

Special You may attempt this once per target per Skill, so a character with several Lores or relevant Skills may get several angles on the same problem.

If you spend more than one action on Recall Knowledge, it gains the following effects:
❷ Study. Roll a Lore or relevant Skill check against the level-based Threshold of your target, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou recall all facts about two topics.
SuccessYou recall all facts about one topic.
FailureYou recall nothing.
Critical FailureYou recall nothing.

actions.name: Aid
actions.requirements: The ally is willing to accept your aid.
actions.description: You use an action to help an ally.
actions.effect:
You must explain to the GM exactly how you're trying to help, and they determine whether you can Aid your ally.

Attempt a Relevant Check. The typical Threshold is 15, but the GM might adjust this Threshold for particularly hard or easy tasks. The GM can add any relevant traits to your action depending on the situation, or even allow you to Aid checks other than skill checks and attack rolls.

Critical Success If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a +2 Situation bonus to the check. If you're a master with the check you attempted, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, it's +4.
Success If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a +1 Situation bonus to the check.
Critical Failure If your ally attempts the check you specified, you grant them a -1 Situation penalty to the check.

actions.name: Interact
actions.effect: Draw or stow a weapon, open a door, pull a potion from your pack, pick something up, work a lever.

actions.name: Release
actions.effect: Drop or let go of something you are holding.

actions.name: Drop Prone
actions.effect: Fall prone.

actions.name: Avert Gaze
actions.effect: Name one creature or object Observed by you. Watch its feet, its shadow, the floor in front of it. Until your next Opportunity you gain a +2 Situation bonus to your Defenses against its effects with the visual trait, and it is Concealed to you.

actions.name: Grab an Edge
actions.requirements: You have a hand free; you may Release ⓿ an item as part of this Reaction to free a hand.
actions.trigger: You fall past an edge, ledge, or handhold within your reach.Requirements You have a hand free. You may Release ⓿ an item as part of this Reaction to free a hand.
actions.effect:
Roll Athletics or Acrobatics, against a Threshold of 15, with the following effects:
Critical SuccessYou catch it and pull yourself up in the same motion. You do not fall.
SuccessYou catch it and hang there. You are Off-Guard.
FailureYou fall, but the damage caused by falling distance is reduced by 10 feet.
Critical FailureYou fall the full distance.

actions.name: Steady the Line
actions.trigger: An adjacent ally's Strike is Stopped and would Expose them.
actions.description: You take the blow's momentum on your own guard, and your ally keeps their footing.
actions.effect: It Exposes nothing.

actions.name: Oathbound
actions.description: When someone breaks faith with you, certainty steadies your hand and steels your resolve.
actions.effect: Name one creature that has either formally challenged you, or that has broken a bargain or a truce with you. You gain a +1 Condition bonus to Attack checks and Defense checks against that creature until the encounter ends.
actions.automation:
[EFFECT MARK: enemies]
[EFFECT ATK: 1 condition; IFT: MARKED]
[EFFECT DEF: 1 condition; IFT: MARKED]

actions.name: Quick Tongue
actions.requirements: You're in a settlement or community, and you haven't used Quick Tongue in this settlement or community within the past month.
actions.trigger: You critically fail a Diplomacy check.
actions.description: You catch a conversation as it slips, turning an ill-chosen word into a chance to begin again.
actions.effect: Reroll the triggering Diplomacy check, using the second result.
